title: MacaulayWinter/seq-triage pipeline parameters
description: Detect sequencing platform, validate metadata, route QC, summarise

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Where the samplesheet comes from and where results go.

input.description: Samplesheet CSV: one row per sample, columns sample, fastq_1, fastq_2, platform, sample_type, molecule.
input.help_text: fastq_2, platform and sample_type are optional. Leave platform blank to have it detected from the reads.

metadata.description: Optional study metadata table (CSV or TSV) with a `sample` column, joined to the samplesheet on it.
metadata.help_text: Study variables can also be extra columns of the samplesheet. Not used for QC; carried to metadata/study_metadata.tsv for the analysis pipelines (D95).

column_guide.description: Optional column guide: one row per study column, saying what it does (role) and how to handle it (type).
column_guide.help_text: Template: assets/column_guide_template.csv; worked example: assets/examples/. Roles: sample_id, subject_id, predictor, outcome, time, block, batch, ignore. Types: binary, categorical, ordinal, count, continuous, proportion, date, text. Without one, metadata/column_guide_draft.csv lists every column to fill in (D95).

outdir.description: Directory for results. Created if it does not exist.

metric_guide.description: TSV of metric definitions and warn/fail thresholds used by the summary report.
metric_guide.help_text: Defaults to assets/metric_guide.tsv. Supply your own to apply local thresholds without editing the pipeline.

publish_dir_mode.description: How results are written to outdir.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: copy is the default so that deleting work/ never empties results/.

downstream_pipelines.description: TSV of rules naming the next nf-core pipeline (pinned version) for each kind of ready sample; seq-triage writes a samplesheet and params file for it.
downstream_pipelines.help_text: Default: assets/downstream_pipelines.tsv. One row per rule: platform, sample type, molecule, target, pipeline, version, commit, samplesheet format, fixed params and values the user must fill in.

cram_fasta.description: Reference FASTA for CRAM input: the genome the CRAM files were written against. Without it, samtools fetches the reference from EBI's registry.

genome_sizes.description: TSV of expected genome sizes per NCBI species taxid, for the depth-of-coverage estimate.
genome_sizes.help_text: Defaults to assets/species_genome_size.tsv, NCBI's species_genome_size.txt (genomes/ASSEMBLY_REPORTS, downloaded 2026-10-23). Columns: species_taxid, min/max/expected_ungapped_length, number_of_genomes.

contamination_screen.title: Contamination screen
contamination_screen.description: Optional: host and contaminant screening with Kraken2 (all routed samples) and Bracken (Illumina, species-level re-estimation).

kraken2_db.description: Kraken2 database: a directory containing hash.k2d, opts.k2d and taxo.k2d, or a .tar.gz of one. Leave unset to skip the screen; the report then says 'not screened'.
kraken2_db.help_text: Species-level results depend on the database. Validated results are reported per database in docs/validation.md.

kraken2_memory_mapping.description: Read the Kraken2 database from disk instead of loading it into memory. Slower, but fits a laptop.

bracken_read_length.description: Read length Bracken uses; the database must contain a matching database<N>mers.kmer_distrib file (prebuilt databases include 100, 150, 200, 250, 300).

species_groups.description: TSV of species judged as one group by the contamination screen (e.g. E. coli and Shigella), with the reason for each.

kraken2_batch.description: Classify every sample in one Kraken2 task, reading the database once (it stays in the node's file cache and each sample uses it with --memory-mapping).
kraken2_batch.help_text: Use with big databases (the full Standard database is ~94 GB), where loading it once per sample dominates the run. Samples then run one after another, and -resume reruns the whole batch if any sample changes. Results are identical to the default per-sample mode.

rrna_screen.title: rRNA screen
rrna_screen.description: Share of ribosomal RNA in RNA samples (D81).

rrna_db.description: rRNA reference for SortMeRNA: a FASTA (.fa/.fasta, optionally .gz), or a .txt manifest listing several (one path or URL per line). Leave unset to skip; RNA samples then say 'not screened'.
rrna_db.help_text: Recommended: SortMeRNA's fast database, https://github.com/sortmerna/sortmerna/releases/download/v7.0.0/smr_v4.3_fast_db.fasta.gz (the v4.3 database series, matching the SortMeRNA 4.3.7 the pipeline runs). Only samples declared molecule = rna on short-read routes are screened.

pathogen_flags.title: Known human pathogens
pathogen_flags.description: Information only (D96): species the contamination screen counts that are on Bartlett et al. 2022's list of bacterial pathogens known to infect humans.

pathogen_list.description: A folder written by bin/pathogen_list.R to use instead of the newest list on Zenodo (offline runs, or to repeat a run exactly).
pathogen_list.help_text: Unset: the newest version of Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.7337534 is looked up at each run and built once into --pathogen_cache.

pathogen_cache.description: Where built copies of the pathogen list are kept, one folder per list version.

skip_pathogen_flags.description: Do not check counted species against the pathogen list.
